title: File:Run-and-tumble motion of a Synechocystis cell.webp
art: Malihe Mehdizadeh Allaf and Hassan Peerhossaini
desc: Illustration of run-and-tumble motion of a Synechocystis cell extracted from the experimental trajectory of a single cell. During run the cell moves quickly from one point to another, while during tumble it remains constrained in a given area and tends to change directions.
